SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.files f ON s.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
  AND f.module = 'httpx._client'
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.line_start >= (SELECT MIN(c.line)
                       FROM code.calls c
                       WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
                         AND c.resolution = 'same_file')
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT cb.base_symbol_id
                           FROM code.class_bases cb
                           WHERE cb.class_symbol_id = s.symbol_id)
  AND s.is_public = FALSE
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT s2.symbol_id
                           FROM code.symbols s2
                           WHERE s2.qualname LIKE 'BaseClient.%'
                             OR s2.name IN (SELECT base.base_name
                                              FROM code.class_bases base
                                              WHERE base.class_symbol_id = (SELECT s3.symbol_id
                                                                 FROM code.symbols s3
                                                                 WHERE s3.qualname = 'BaseClient')))
  AND s.summary = ''
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;
